scripts.setup: npm run setup:global && npm run setup:local
scripts.test: clasp push --force && clasp deploy && clasp run summarizeAndSendDailyEmail
scripts.deploy: clasp push --force && clasp deploy && echo 'Deployed successfully! Delete the old trigger and create a new one with this new version.' && echo 'https://script.google.com/home/projects/18591sxMWX_gcdwUgzcfiQcjzKhZGxWj1WPJPHrznwuhMNZDQbK7HaEz0/edit'
scripts.deployments:cleanup: (clasp deployments | grep -v @$(cat package.json | jq .meta.activeDeploymentId) | grep -v @HEAD | grep "\- " | cut -d' ' -f2 | xargs -I {} clasp undeploy {}) && clasp deployments

meta._activeDeploymentId: NOTE: this needs to be updated every time we update the trigger to a specific deployment
